author: Animalogic
description:
Think you're looking at a jellyfish? Think again! The Portuguese Man o' War is one of the most fascinating and bizarre sights in the world's warm waters. While they may look like a single animal, they are actually siphonophores, a complex colony of thousands of genetically identical clones working together to survive.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
